title: Nanam durian: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: Nanam durian: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: Nanam durian is a durian variety from Severino Belviz. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Nanam is a registered durian variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2000 as NSIC 2000 Dr 08. Severino Belviz bred it. Its record notes a yield of 30 to 40 fruits.

heroImage.alt: Young fruit trees planted in straight rows on cleared red soil, the kind of farm where Nanam durian is grown

blocks.text: Compare it with the others in our [durian variety finder](/crop-varieties/durian), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for fruit trees](/land-preparation/fruit-tree-land-preparation).

items: **Yield:** a recorded yield of 30 to 40 fruits.

blocks.text: When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. Its record notes a yield of 30 to 40 fruits. It bears fruit in August September. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.
The pests and diseases that hit durian fields most often: [mealybug](/pests/mealybug). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

A fruit of Nanam weighs about 2400 grams, and its shape is oblong. The flesh is bright yellow and sweet w/ slight and glutinous. Its sweetness measured 30 to 34 degrees Brix, the share of sugar in the juice. Most table fruit tastes sweet from about 12 Brix up. The edible part is 34.51 percent of the fruit. Its fruiting season is August September.
Where and when to plant Nanam durian

Davao growers plant named clones such as Puyat and Arancillo for their thick, creamy flesh and small seeds. Plant grafted trees of a known clone, and mix clones for better fruit set. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Nanam?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
